summary: Chart of Accounts feature tested: POST /api/finance/chart-of-accounts creates accounts successfully with all 5 types (revenue/expense/liability/asset/equity), GET returns updated list, duplicate code rejection works, default type (asset) assigned when not specified. UI modal tested with type selection for all 5 types.
passed_tests: ✅ POST /api/finance/chart-of-accounts creates revenue type account successfully
✅ POST /api/finance/chart-of-accounts creates expense type account successfully
✅ POST /api/finance/chart-of-accounts creates liability type account successfully
✅ POST /api/finance/chart-of-accounts creates asset type account successfully
✅ POST /api/finance/chart-of-accounts creates equity type account successfully
✅ POST without type defaults to 'asset' type
✅ Duplicate code rejection returns Arabic error message (رمز الحساب موجود مسبقاً)
✅ Created account appears in GET list immediately
✅ UI: Chart of Accounts page loads at /accounting/chart-of-accounts
✅ UI: Modal opens with code, name, type fields
✅ UI: Type select has all 5 options (أصول, التزامات, حقوق ملكية, إيرادات, مصروفات)
✅ UI: Form submission creates account via API
✅ UI: Modal closes on successful submission
✅ UI: List updates immediately without page reload
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed accounts during testing for different account types
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chart of Accounts POST endpoint works correctly. Route is /api/finance/chart-of-accounts (requires workshop_id query param). Frontend page at /accounting/chart-of-accounts with login required (username: مدير). Type select supports: asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense. Test accounts created with TEST_ prefix can be cleaned up.
testing_approach: Backend: pytest with 11 test cases covering all account types, validation, and integration. Frontend: Playwright automation testing modal flow and type selection.
